content:
Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that its former employees "for the benefit of OpenAI" stole trade secrets.

It is reported that as part of the litigation process, Apple has directly contacted dozens of former employees currently working at OpenAI.

According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued preservation letters to approximately 40 former employees.

A preservation letter is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organization, requesting that they preserve documents, records and other evidence that may be related to a legal dispute. Such letters typically specify the particular items that must be preserved.

Apple suspects that the theft of trade secrets may not be limited to the individuals named in last week's complaint, hence this move.

In short, Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, along with former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.
